scripts.i18n-validate: npm run scaffold:dicts && npm run check-dicts
scripts.check-all:dry-run: echo Would run: check-dicts -> check-meta -> check-required-only -> check-translation-sync -> check-topbar-footer
scripts.patch-all: npm run patch-missing && npm run fix-topbar-footer
scripts.fix-all:dry-run: echo Would run: patch-dicts -> patch-missing -> fix-footer
scripts.repair: npm run fix-all && npm run check-all
scripts.repair:dry-run: echo Would run: patch-dicts -> patch-missing -> fix-footer -> check-all
scripts.repair:quick: npm run patch-all && npm run check-all
scripts.repair:force: npm run patch-dicts:force && npm run fix-all && npm run check-all
scripts.repair:strict: npm run patch-all && npm run check-all:strict && npm run lint && npm run coverage:strict
scripts.reset:all: npm run validate:repair && npm run sync && npm run postreset && pwsh -Command "Write-Host '=== Final Reset Summary ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-ChildItem ./logs -Filter '*.txt' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 1 | Get-Content"
scripts.ci:reset: npm run validate:repair && npm run sync && npm run postreset --silent
scripts.coverage:view: npm run test:coverage && npx open-cli coverage/index.html
scripts.ci-check:dry-run: echo Would run CI pipeline: clean -> check-all:strict -> lint -> coverage:strict
scripts.ci-repair: npm run repair:force && npm run check-all:strict && npm run lint && npm run coverage:strict
scripts.ci-repair:dry-run: echo Would run CI repair pipeline: repair:force -> check-all:strict -> lint -> coverage:strict
scripts.validated: npm run check-all && npm run ci-check:dry-run
scripts.guardian:i18n: npm run check-dicts:strict && npm run check-translation-sync:strict && npm run check-topbar-footer:strict && npm run check-placeholders
scripts.guardian:videos: npm run check-video-sync && npm run lint
scripts.guardian:i18n: npm run check-dicts:strict && npm run check-translation-sync:strict && npm run check-topbar-footer:strict && npm run check-placeholders
scripts.guardian:precommit: npm run guardian:i18n && npm run guardian:videos && npm run lint
